stations.name: Dome field (5 x 4 domes, 18-44 m)
stations.note: Drive in from the west edge, any line. Domes of varied size, closely spaced.

stations.name: Gap jump S (4 m lips, 46 m gap)
stations.note: Take-off ramp, gap, landing ramp. Launch at 55 mph or more and hold throttle (82+ mph at the lip). Slower comes up short into the lip wall.
